facts.text: Jon expressed admiration for Gina's decision to combine her interests into an online store.

evidence.quote: Wow, that's awesome! Combining your two interests into a store is super cool.
Thanks! How is biz going? I hope it's going well!

facts.text: Jon mentioned that starting his business has been difficult but he is determined to succeed.

evidence.quote: Losing my job was hard, but I'm livin' my dreams now. Startin' my biz has been tough but I'm gonna make it!

evidence.quote: Starting and running my own biz has had its ups and downs - but it's been an amazing ride!
